comment: Markets watch fallback (owner directive 2026-08-11). When the live Al-Quds fetch fails (PEX publishes no API), the strip renders this value with its date. The daily editor refreshes it each cycle from pex.ps / Investing.com PLE — always the latest CLOSE, always dated, never invented.
